run_awq_quantization: run AWQ quantization on a Qwen3 Coder MoE model using llmcompressor oneshot with W4A16 scheme
create_awq_recipe: create an AWQ quantization recipe with AWQModifier targeting Linear layers while ignoring lm_head and gate layers
build_calibration_dataset: build a calibration dataset from HuggingFace datasets by tokenizing chat messages with a tokenizer
test_quantized_model: test a quantized LLM by generating text from a prompt after loading and dispatching the model
summarize_quantize_save: summarize quantizing a transformer model with AWQ and saving the quantized model and tokenizer to disk
